questions.question: After the ark came to rest in the LORD's house, what did King David put some Levites in charge of?
At the tabernacle, the other Levites helped Aaron and his sons do the work of the Most Holy Place. True or false?
Aaron and his sons presented offerings on the altar of burnt offering and the altar of incense. What were these offerings for?

answers.text: To ask for rain on the land

questions.question: Besides King David's singers, what were the other Levites assigned to?

answers.text: Every kind of service of the tabernacle
Guarding the gates of the king's palace
Collecting the taxes from every tribe
